description: EventEnvelope: see $defs/EventEnvelope. Standard Webhooks payload {type, timestamp, data}. The same envelope frames WebSocket messages. The event id travels in the webhook-id header. data always carries clinic_id and session_id and never a name, a date of birth or free text.
